H01.description: Containment of hook scripts is only checked when the leaf itself is a symlink, so a symlinked intermediate directory under .claude/ can point a registered hook at a file outside .claude/ without being refused.

H02.description: The check only verifies that a floor gate's script exists on disk, not that settings.json registers it, so an unregistered floor gate hook (never runs) leaves --check green.

H03.description: render_hooks_ref only counts the markers and does not check that the end marker follows the begin marker, so a misplaced end marker makes the awk pass drop all content after the begin marker from the hooks reference.

H04.description: The depth-1 checkout has no origin/main ref, so the floor-snapshot proof that compares against origin/main skips silently in CI.

H05.description: resolve_toggles applies LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES even when not in arm mode and for the baseline arm, so a stale inherited variable silently alters a baseline or non-arm run.

H06.description: A failed jq rewrite of constraints.json in the karpathy_block toggle is swallowed by the && chain and the toggle is reported as applied without verifying the Karpathy rows are gone.

H07.description: LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT is recorded without checking it is a hex id or matches the prompt tree's HEAD, so trials from different trees can claim the same source_commit and pass the skew check.

H08.description: Header comment updated to describe the new default executor model.

H09.description: The default model claude-fable-5-1 had a trial refused by a safeguard, and the CLI then fell back to Opus partway through the session, so a default run was not homogeneous in executor model.

H10.description: The --batch regex accepts '.' and '..', so the batch directory resolves to the suite directory or the results root instead of a child batch directory.

H11.description: verify_corpus only checks the files listed in SHA256SUMS, so a file added to the corpus without being listed reaches the sandbox under an unchanged corpus digest.

H12.description: The pristine-worktree check ignores git-ignored files, so leftovers from an earlier run (.loa.config.yaml, .run/) get copied into every sandbox under one recorded commit.

H13.description: Transport failures are detected by grepping the agent's own output with broad patterns ('network', any '5xx '), so the agent under test can trigger a retry just by mentioning such text.

H14.description: The trial launch passes an inherited LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES from the parent environment to execute-agent.sh, overriding the suite-declared arm toggles.

H15.description: The secret redaction patterns miss common credential shapes (PEM private keys, JWTs, GitHub fine-grained/app tokens, Google/Stripe keys, generic api_key/token assignments), and \s in the password/secret patterns can match across newlines, so secrets can be copied into the corpus unredacted.

H16.description: The scope exclusion does not exclude a root CLAUDE.md, so a fixture can carry an instruction file that Claude Code may load for the agent under test.

H17.description: Test updated to pass the prompt tree's real HEAD as the source commit.

H18.description: Test assertion updated and a new AT-12 regression test added for source commit and toggle validation.

H19.description: Test expectation updated to the new default model id.

H20.description: Floor-snapshot tests reworked and new FS-5/FS-6 tests added.

I01.description: Fixes the --screen batch handling, which is a later feature that is not in the head code.

I02.description: Hardens later code (--max-usd spend accounting, the LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE handling in sandbox-mount) that the head shown does not contain.

I03.description: An analysis/docs PR, not a defect report.

I04.description: Fixes later grader scope-map code that no hunk here touches; it cannot be tied to head.

I05.description: Fixes the edges of the r1a grader fix, which is post-merge code.

I06.description: Hardens later grader code (the workspace head fallback, the header cap) that the head shown does not contain.

I07.description: Adds the new @L<n> grammar and the --sync-labels feature for label drift; a feature addition, not a head defect.

I08.description: Fixes the --sync-labels code introduced in I07, after merge.

I09.description: Audit-round hardening of the later --sync-labels and build_manifest code; it cannot be confirmed against the head shown.

I10.description: A summary PR for later bug micro-sprints, not a head defect.
